text: ＊　＊で　だげきこうげきに　つよくなった！

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い to く and adding なる means 'become' that way. つよくなった = 'became strong'.

patterns.name: 〜につよい
patterns.span: だげきこうげきに　つよくなった
patterns.explanation: に before つよい shows what something holds up well against. だげきこうげきに つよく = 'strong against physical attacks'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what caused the change: 'because of' or 'thanks to'. ＊で = 'thanks to ＊'.
